home.headline: YOUR TRACK, MIXED
home.subhead: We mix and master your track until it competes on streaming platforms. Track by track, with technical judgement and no hype.

services.heading: PICK WHERE
services.subhead: Three ways to work with us. If you are not sure which one fits, send the track and we will tell you.

items.heading: MIXING
items.body: We put the track in order: every instrument in its place, the vocal up front, the dynamics intact.

items.heading: MASTERING
items.body: The final step. Competitive loudness and even translation across headphones, car and speakers.

items.heading: MIXING + MASTERING
items.body: The track solved end to end. This is what most artists go for.
features: Everything in mixing, plus the master
Up to 5 revisions depending on tier

services.launchNote: Launch pricing. Listed in US dollars, with the Argentine peso equivalent for local clients.

why.heading: SOUND SHOULD NOT BE
why.subhead: There are artists with great songs that never end up sounding the way they imagined. Not because they lack talent, but because they lack resources, know-how, or someone to help take it further.

points.heading: WE TAKE YOUR SOUND FURTHER
points.body: We mix emerging artists with a sound that is modern, clean, dynamic and emotional. We are not after a song that sounds like everyone else's — we want it to sound like you.

points.heading: A BRIDGE FOR INDEPENDENT ARTISTS
points.body: You do not need a label, a studio of your own, or to know how to mix. If you have a song and something to say, we take care of the rest.

points.heading: NO MIDDLEMEN, ARTIST TO ARTIST
points.body: You talk directly to whoever is working on your song. We understand what you want to get across, we work from that, and we stay with you through the process.

why.punchline: Parallel exists to close that gap.

beforeAfter.heading: THE DIFFERENCE
beforeAfter.subhead: Two finished masters, exactly as they are delivered. The before of each track goes up once we have it.

items.heading: TRACK 02
items.body: Mix with no body and no air

items.question: What do I need to send you my track?
items.answer: Separate stems, 24 bit / 48 kHz, no clipping, and a reference for how you'd like it to sound. Missing something? Send it anyway and we'll figure it out.

items.question: What if I recorded everything on my phone, or have no stems?
items.answer: Write to us anyway. We can work with less: it's not a hard requirement, it's the ideal case.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Depends on the package: 1 or 2 on mixing, up to 5 on mixing plus mastering. We tell you the exact number before we start.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Mixing from $15,000 ARS, mastering from $10,000 ARS, mixing + mastering from $25,000 ARS. Launch pricing, with a USD equivalent for clients abroad.

items.question: Do I need a label or my own studio?
items.answer: No. If you have a song and something to say, we take care of the rest.

items.question: What does the process look like?
items.answer: You send us the stems, we mix and send you a v1 for your notes, then we apply the final master with WAV files ready for platforms.

items.question: Do I talk directly with whoever mixes my song?
items.answer: Yes. No middlemen: you talk to whoever is working on your track, artist to artist.

leadForm.heading: TELL US WHAT YOU HAVE
leadForm.subhead: Four details and that's it. We'll listen and tell you what can be done, no commitment.

process.heading: How we work on your track
process.subhead: A simple, direct process to take your song from the original tracks to a master ready to be heard.

steps.heading: Send your stems
steps.body: You send us the tracks exported from bar zero, organized and with no effects. We get everything ready to start.

steps.heading: Mix and revision
steps.body: We work every element of the track to get a sound that's clean and dynamic. We send you v1 so you can give us notes.

steps.heading: Final master
steps.body: We apply the final master: loudness and impact to compete with today's releases. We deliver the final WAV files.

stack.lead: Bring the idea. We handle the rest.

lines.title: You wrote it. Sang it a thousand times.
Hearing it the way it sounds in your head.

disc.heading: IT'S NOT YOUR SONG.
disc.subhead: Put it in the same playlist as your favourite artist. If yours sounds quieter, smaller and further away, you're not short on talent. You're short one step.

items.title: Professional mixing
items.body: Frequency balance, controlled dynamics and spatial depth. Every element in its place, pushing the song.

items.title: Mastering
items.body: The final step. Competitive loudness and even translation on headphones, car and speakers.

items.title: Vocal treatment
items.body: Transparent tuning, aggressive compression and modern spatial effects. Vocals up front, without sounding processed.

items.title: Beat production
items.body: We build the instrumental around your idea, or hand you exclusive beats ready to record on.

about.heading: Made by artists
about.paragraph1: We're Pedro and Ian, producers, not an agency. We record from home and live inside the music you're about to hear. We know what it costs to find your sound — it costs us too.
about.paragraph2: With Parallel you find the sound you've been chasing. We only have one priority: your track holding up against whatever you're already listening to.
about.punchline: You're one song away from finally hearing yourself the way you always meant to.
about.photoAlt: The two producers behind Parallel Studios

mixCraft.heading: The craft of mixing
mixCraft.lead: Your vocal is buried under the beat.

items.label: PARALLEL COMPRESSION
items.body: We give your drums or your vocal weight and punch without killing the original dynamics. Advanced routing so everything sounds huge but natural.

items.label: SURGICAL EQ
items.body: We clear the frequencies muddying the mix, and make room for every element to shine in its own place.

items.label: VOCAL TUNING
items.body: From transparent correction to aggressive autotune effects, depending on what the track asks for.

items.label: STAGE AND DEPTH
items.body: We work panning, reverbs and delays into a three-dimensional stereo image. Your track will never sound flat again.

masteringDeep.heading: Final mastering
masteringDeep.body: A mastering chain with an A/B reference against your favourite track. Competitive loudness without destroying your music.

notice.heading: Legal notice
notice.intro: This document governs access to and use of this site and all of its content. Browsing it means accepting these terms. If you disagree with any of them, do not use the site.

sections.heading: Site owner
body: The details of the party responsible for this site are the ones listed in the table above. Any question about this legal notice can be sent to the email address shown there.

sections.heading: Purpose and acceptance
body: This notice governs the use of the site that the owner makes available to users. By browsing it you accept these terms as published at the time of your visit.
The owner may change the presentation, configuration and content of the site, as well as these terms, at any time. The date of the last revision appears at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Terms of use
body: By using the site you agree to:
items: Use it in good faith and in accordance with the law.
Not attempt to access restricted areas, or alter or damage how the site works.
Not use the contact form to send unlawful content, unsolicited advertising or malicious software.
Be responsible for the accuracy of the details you enter in the contact form.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: The texts, design, trademarks, logos, photographs and audio files published on the site belong to the owner or are used with permission. They may not be reproduced, distributed, publicly communicated or altered without written permission.

Material a client hands over to be worked on — demos, tracks, stems, lyrics — remains the client's. The studio uses it solely to deliver the contracted service, and does not publish it or show it as an example without express authorisation.

sections.heading: Pricing and contracting
body: Published prices are stated in Argentine pesos, are “from” figures and are informational: they are not a binding offer. The final price of each job is confirmed in writing before work starts, based on the material and the agreed scope.
The US dollar equivalent shown next to each price is a conversion reference for clients abroad, not a second price list.

sections.heading: Liability
body: The owner aims to keep the site available and its information correct and up to date, but cannot guarantee the absence of interruptions, delays, errors or omissions, and is not liable for damage arising from them.
The site links to third-party services such as WhatsApp and Instagram. The owner does not control those sites and is not responsible for their content, availability or privacy practices.

sections.heading: Partial invalidity
body: If any clause of this notice is declared void or unenforceable, the rest remains in force and is interpreted in line with the original purpose of the document.

sections.heading: Governing law and jurisdiction
body: This notice is governed by Argentine law. Any dispute will be submitted to the ordinary courts of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, without prejudice to the venue that applies where the user qualifies as a consumer under Consumer Protection Act 24,240.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Here is what personal data we collect, what we use it for, how long we keep it and what you can ask us to do with it.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: The controller is the site owner, whose full details appear in the legal notice. For anything related to your personal data you can write to the contact email listed there.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: We only collect what you give us or what the server records in order to serve you the site:
items: What you enter in the contact form: name, email, WhatsApp (optional) and the message you write.
What you send us over WhatsApp, email or Instagram, including audio files and download links.
Technical data the server records when serving each page: IP address, browser type, date and time, and the page requested.

sections.heading: What we do not collect
body: We do not ask for sensitive data. We do not process payments on the site, so you will never enter card or bank details here. We also do not run analytics or any tool that tracks your browsing.

sections.heading: What we use it for
items: Answering your enquiry and putting together a quote.
Delivering the contracted service and staying in touch during the work.
Meeting legal, accounting and tax obligations.
body: We do not use your data for advertising, we do not send newsletters, and we do not sell or share it with third parties for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: Legal basis
body: Processing is based on your consent, given when you send the form or write to us through any channel, and on performance of the contract once a job is under way. It is governed by Personal Data Protection Act 25,326 of Argentina.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Enquiries that do not turn into a job are kept for up to one year from the last contact. Client data is kept for the duration of the relationship and afterwards for as long as tax and accounting obligations require.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
items: The site's hosting provider, which stores technical data and the messages sent through the form.
The email provider we use to handle enquiries.
Public authorities, where a legal rule requires it.
body: These providers act on our behalf and may only process the data in order to provide us with their service.

sections.heading: International transfers
body: Some of those providers host information on servers outside Argentina. Where that happens, we contract services offering an adequate level of protection and sign the corresponding contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask us at any time to:
items: Access the data we hold about you.
Rectify or update it if it is wrong or has changed.
Delete it, where no legal obligation requires us to keep it.
Withdraw the consent you gave, without affecting processing carried out beforehand.

sections.heading: How to exercise them
body: Write to the contact email in the legal notice telling us what you need. We may ask you to prove your identity before responding.

Under section 14(3) of Act 25,326, the data subject may exercise the right of access free of charge at intervals of no less than six months, unless a legitimate interest to do otherwise is demonstrated.

The Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública, the supervisory authority for Act 25,326, is empowered to handle complaints and claims brought in connection with breaches of personal data protection rules.

sections.heading: Minors
body: The site is intended for people over 18. If you are a minor, you need permission from a parent or guardian to contract a service or send us your data.

sections.heading: Security
body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect the information. No system is infallible: if we detect an incident affecting your data we will tell you, and notify the authority where required.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: If we change how we handle data, we update this document and the date in the header. It is worth checking back occasionally.

cookies.heading: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This site uses a single cookie, and it is a technical one. There is no analytics, no advertising and no social media pixels — which is why you will not see a consent banner either.

locale.purpose: Remembers which language you are browsing in so each page is served in that language.
locale.duration: Session only: the browser deletes it on close.

sections.heading: What a cookie is
body: It is a small file a site stores in your browser when you visit, letting it remember something between one page and the next. Some are technical — needed for the site to work — and others are analytics or advertising cookies, used to measure or profile you.

sections.heading: Which cookie this site uses
body: The one in the table above, and no others. It is a technical cookie: it stores which language you are browsing in so the following pages reach you in that language. It cannot identify you, holds no personal data and is not shared with anyone.

sections.heading: What it does not use
items: Analytics or audience measurement cookies.
Advertising, remarketing or profiling cookies.
Embedded social media buttons or pixels.
Any sale or transfer of browsing data to third parties.

sections.heading: Third-party services
body: The site's fonts are loaded from Adobe Fonts (Adobe Inc.). That service sets no cookies on this domain, but when your browser requests the file it sends technical data such as your IP address and browser type. Their privacy policy is published on Adobe's site.
Links to WhatsApp and Instagram take you off this site. What happens there is governed by those platforms' policies, not by this one.

sections.heading: How to turn it off
body: Every browser lets you block or delete cookies from its settings or privacy options. Blocking this site's cookie breaks nothing: the only effect is that the site stops remembering your language and shows the one it detects by default on each visit.

sections.heading: Changes
body: If we add any cookie in the future, we will update this document and the date in the header before installing it.
